descricao_original: The following series of images shows illustrations of individual stages of the cell cycle paired with those stages as seen through the light microscope. Additionally, the series of cell stages appears across the top of each image for reference. For diagrammatic purposes, only a single pair of homologous chromosomes is represented in each illustration.
